en: An inclined plane reduces the lifting force needed for a heavy box by increasing the distance over which you push it.
A single fixed pulley redirects your downward pull on a rope, causing the attached load to move upward against gravity.
Rubber brake pads squeeze a bicycle wheel rim, creating friction that converts kinetic energy into heat to stop the bike.
The Moon's gravitational pull on Earth's oceans causes the water to bulge outward, creating high tides on the side facing it.
Running an electric current through a wire coil wrapped around an iron nail aligns its magnetic domains, temporarily creating an electromagnet.
Closing a switch completes an electrical circuit, allowing electrons to flow from the battery through the wire to light the bulb.
Light slows down and bends when traveling from air into water, making a submerged pencil appear broken at the surface.
Striking a drum causes its stretched skin to vibrate, pushing adjacent air molecules to transmit sound waves to your ear.
Holding a hot metal spoon transfers thermal energy from the soup to the handle through direct molecular collisions, warming your hand.
Plants absorb sunlight and convert its light energy into chemical energy, storing it within glucose molecules during photosynthesis.
As a roller coaster car climbs a steep hill, its kinetic energy transforms into stored gravitational potential energy.
Pushing the north pole of one bar magnet toward the north pole of another causes them to repel and push apart.
